---
title: Wrapping up
---

When a project ends or you no longer need the storage, you can terminate the SciStor project through this form: [Request to terminate SciStor](https://services.vu.nl/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=d87c98f547fe8150bfa46d72e36d43aa).

Before terminating your SciStor project folder we recommend archiving data that you would like to preserve in [Yoda](https://rdm.vu.nl/tools/yoda/index.html).
